name: Tomas Medeckis
headline: AI trainer. Marketing expert. 5 million impressions on Linkedin

sections.bio:
4 million organic views on Linkedin. 
Impressions per post are from 10k to 400K. Depends on the subject.

posts.text:
Jack Dorsey has been warning that social media feeds are doing much more than simply
organizing posts.

His concern is that the ranking systems behind them quietly shape what people notice, believe, and keep coming back to.

Instead of giving every platform that control, Dorsey has argued users should be able to choose which algorithm runs their feed.

Basically, if apps can be customizable, he thinks the thing deciding what you see all day should be too.

For the first time, Al has designed complete
viruses from scratch.

Stanford researchers used an Al trained on DNA instead of text and asked it to write entire virus genomes. 
They tested around 300 designs in the lab. 16 came out as real, working viruses that killed bacteria.

These are bacteriophages, they infect bacteria only and cannot infect humans. 

The Al was also trained without any human viruses in its data. The point is medical. 

Antibiotic resistance killed 1.27 million people in 2019, and these Al viruses beat bacteria that had already resisted the natural version.

But biosecurity experts at Johns Hopkins warned in the same journal that the ability to write viral genomes with Al now exists, and the rules to control it do not.

Source:"Generative design of bacteriophages with genome language models," published in Science, August 6 2026.
